worst_gate: Photo-tier whole-property stitch: any picture in, results out
why_this_gate: Photos are the mandatory floor tier; derived-sample photo and video runs both return no dimension at all, so this is the worst gate in the local benchmark.

failing_number.metric: rooms with at least one non-null dimension (photo tier, derived sample)

root_cause_hypothesis: Photos carry no poses. When structure-from-motion fails to register at least two overlapping views, the pipeline abandons the room and emits nothing, although each photo already has a usable metric depth prediction on its own.
evidence: COLMAP log: No images with matches / Failed to create any sparse model on the derived stills.
run_rgb_capture converts any SfM failure straight into empty_room(); depth predictions are never used without poses.
Photo features per image are low in places (39 and 282 SIFT features in two of seven stills).
intended_fix: When SfM fails, run the metric-depth model on each photo, back-project with a pinhole prior, fit floor and ceiling planes in that single view, and report ceiling height per room with wide, labelled intervals. Footprint and adjacency stay null.

prediction.rooms_with_any_dimension_after: 1 of 1, if at least one still shows both floor and ceiling; 0 of 1 otherwise
prediction.accuracy: Not predicted. Learned scale and an assumed focal length mean an error above the 8 percent photo gate is likely. No physical ground truth exists, so accuracy stays unscored.
prediction.gate_status_after: Photo whole-property stitch still FAILS: no footprint, adjacency or overlap-free plan is produced.

success_criteria: Rooms with any dimension rises from 0 of 1 to 1 of 1 with labelled, uncalibrated intervals and no fabricated footprint.
reproduce: uv run --extra rgb brynz derive single_room --out out/derived && uv run --extra rgb brynz fixloop out/derived/photos --out out/fixloop
limitations: Derived stills are cut from one video, not independent iPhone photos. LiDAR-relative comparison is a pseudo-reference.
